entities.name: Cathedral Basilica of Our Lady of Coromoto

entities.summary: The Cathedral Basilica of Our Lady of Coromoto or more commonly Guanare Cathedral, is an eighteenth century church dedicated to the Virgin of Coromoto and located as its name indicates in Guanare, capital of Portuguesa state in Venezuela.
